title: Returning Extra Change
paragraphs: Wafa berbelanja bahan makanan di toko kecil dekat kantornya saat jam makan siang. Sesampainya di rumah, ia memeriksa struk belanjanya dan menyadari bahwa kasir memberinya kembalian lebih banyak secara tidak sengaja. Jumlahnya kecil, tapi Wafa tetap memutuskan untuk kembali ke toko itu keesokan harinya. "Saya rasa kemarin Anda memberi saya kembalian lebih," katanya kepada kasir, sambil mengembalikan uang itu dengan jujur.

Kasir itu memeriksa ulang mesin kasirnya dan memastikan kesalahan itu memang terjadi sore sebelumnya. Ia menyebutkan bahwa kebanyakan pelanggan tidak akan repot-repot mengembalikan uang sekecil itu. Wafa berjalan kembali ke kantor dengan perasaan lebih ringan, bukan karena uangnya, tapi karena ia memilih kejujuran daripada kenyamanan, meski tidak akan ada yang tahu perbedaannya jika ia hanya diam saja.
answerKey: Wafa buys groceries at a small shop near her office during her lunch break. When she gets home, she checks her receipt and realizes the cashier gave her too much change by mistake, without noticing. The amount is small, but Wafa decides to walk back to the shop the next day anyway. "I think you gave me extra change yesterday," she tells the cashier, handing back the money honestly. The cashier double-checks the register and confirms the mistake really happened the previous evening. He mentions that most customers would not have bothered to return such a small amount of money. Wafa walks back to work feeling lighter, not because of the money, but because she chose honesty over convenience, even when nobody would have known the difference if she had simply kept quiet.
